summary: simple-date-formatter-util-4 exfiltrates cloud IAM credentials on install
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that uses curl to query cloud instance metadata services (AWS 169.254.169.254, Alibaba 100.100.100.200, Tencent metadata.tencentyun.com/169.254.0.23), retrieves the IAM role name from the AWS IMDS security-credentials endpoint, fetches the temporary STS credentials for that role, and POSTs the response bodies to attacker-controlled interactsh collectors at ycrqyyjhwepdmhjifyccxss1hrks8lcd2.oast.fun and safjhdvsfwzhieemkdzbgr54r0yjhrmok.oast.fun. The package name presents as a date-formatting utility; the postinstall behavior is unrelated cloud-credential harvesting that fires automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
